packages.title: A row with a deadline doesn't say «Sin fecha»
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, batch e, round 2. Round 1 (e) built D1 (P235, UX-1715): a voice move to a day of a task that has only a deadline moves its deadline and leaves it with no planned day. That work, with P236 and P239, is uncommitted in the main checkout. Work in the main checkout, or in a worktree on its HEAD with round 1's work seeded. Before you edit, check that App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:48 reads `if (date == null) return showUndated ? context.l10n.noDate : null;`. If it doesn't, stop and report what you found. Reading git is fine; never change git state.

UX-1725 (S2, regression R1A-1 of round 1 (e), from P235, verify-e-r1-A). Calendar's day list after a voice move of a task with only a deadline: render App/build/ux/commands/applied.bulk-applied.es.light.1x.png shows the row «Pagar la factura del gas» reading «🕒 Sin fecha   Vence vie, 23 de oct», right above «4 tareas movidas al vie, 23 de oct». The row rule isn't new (`_dateLine` prints `noDate` for any row with no `displayDate` while `showUndated` is set), but D1 now makes it the ending of every voice move of such a task. The first words the user reads, «Sin fecha», contradict the confirmation beside them: «¿Se ha guardado o no?»

Fix (subtract, no new copy): in `TaskTile._dateLine` (App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:48), replace the line with `if (date == null) return showUndated && task.deadline == null ? context.l10n.noDate : null;`. The test `task.deadline == null` is the same one the row uses for its deadline line (:104), so every row that loses «Sin fecha» shows «Vence …» (EN “Due …”, CA «Termini: …») instead, and TalkBack, which reads the row's details (:217), reads «Vence …» and no «Sin fecha». Update the doc comment of `showUndated` (:39) to: `/// Whether a row with no date and no deadline says so. On the Sin fecha page it doesn't; a row with a deadline shows its «Vence …» line instead.`

Scope of the change: it applies to every TaskTile (Calendar's day list, the day timeline, the Tareas root, project pages). That is intended: the reviewer asked that a deadline-only row on Tareas also lose «Sin fecha». A row with no date and no deadline keeps «Sin fecha» everywhere it shows it today, and the Sin fecha page (`showUndated: false`, App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart:771) still shows none.

Preview: in App/test/ux_previews/commands_previews.dart, the 'bulk-applied' description (about :900) changes from «… «Pagar la factura del gas» (only a deadline) among them reading «Vence <tomorrow>», with no «Fecha límite vencida», …» to «… «Pagar la factura del gas» (only a deadline) among them reading only «Vence <tomorrow>», with no «Sin fecha» and no «Fecha límite vencida», …»; leave the rest of the sentence as it is. From App/, re-render with `flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_UX_PREVIEWS=true test/ux_previews/ux_previews_test.dart --plain-name commands/` and confirm in applied.bulk-applied.es.light.1x.png that the gas row reads only «Vence <tomorrow>». Then re-render `--plain-name tasks/` and check that no tasks/ description claims «Sin fecha» on a row with a deadline (only commands_previews.dart:855 and tasks_previews.dart:242 mention «Sin fecha», and neither is about such a row).

Tests: the tests that pin «Sin fecha» on a row use tasks with no deadline and must keep passing unchanged: App/test/task_rows_test.dart 'UX-1418 / UX-1512: on the Sin fecha page no row shows «Sin fecha»; on the Tareas root an undated row still does' (about :490-515) and App/test/home_screen_test.dart's 'Algún día' row (about :594-599). If any other test fails because it pinned «Sin fecha» on a task with a deadline, it rightly changes: update it and name it in your notes. ux-tester writes the acceptance tests (App/test/task_rows_test.dart is the natural home for the row tests).

Don't touch: the rest of `_dateLine` (rows with a date, `showDate`, `markOverdue`, `overdueDate`), the deadline line (:102-108, :141-148), the capture sheet's and review editor's own «Sin fecha» lines (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart, the capture sheet's date line), the «Sin fecha» chip of «Elegir día» and of Calendar's «Cambiar fecha», the ARB catalogs (no new copy), App/lib/services/, App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart, App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart, and Backend/.

The render commands/applied.bulk-applied.es.light.1x.png shows the gas row reading only «Vence <tomorrow>», and its description in App/build/ux/INDEX.md says so.
